Package Presentation.Controllers

Class GameController

java.lang.Object
Presentation.Controllers.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
ActionListener, EventListener
public class GameController extends Object implements ActionListener
GameController class implements the ActionListener interface to handle actions performed in the GameView class, such as clicking buttons.
